subject.title: fix(feishu): avoid mention forwarding when bot open id is unavailable

question: Should Feishu mention forwarding intentionally fail closed whenever `botOpenId` is unavailable?
rationale: The source fix is narrow and proof is sufficient, but it changes behavior during bot identity probe or recovery gaps, which the repository treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept fail-closed identity guard
options.body: Merge after removing or explicitly accepting the release-owned CHANGELOG edit; this prevents accidental forwarding when OpenClaw cannot know whether the bot was addressed.

options.title: Preserve legacy identity-gap forwarding
options.body: Keep DM mention forwarding while bot identity is missing, accepting the current risk of forwarding mentions when the bot identity is unknown.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed identity guard
recommendation.body: Merge after removing or explicitly accepting the release-owned CHANGELOG edit; this prevents accidental forwarding when OpenClaw cannot know whether the bot was addressed.
